title: Compass Beacon: continuous model-ecosystem radar and procurement trigger kit
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a continuously running competitive radar (Compass Beacon) that fuses public model signals (releases, quantization artifacts, speed benchmarks, pricing changes), telemetry from our runtime (latency by region/model, error spikes, quant fallback rates), and partner/market receipts (vendor capacity alerts, procurement notices) into an operable procurement trigger kit. This ticket covers the PM scope: signal taxonomy, thresholds for automated alerts, procurement trigger definitions, initial dashboard designs for Console, and a playbook for SDR/sales handoff and SRE escalation. The goal is to reduce surprise vendor outages and shorten procurement reaction time from days to hours by giving a prioritized, evidence-backed trigger with recommended mitigation steps.
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy published and approved by Research/Applied ML and SRE (doc link in first comment)
Thresholds defined for three procurement trigger levels (inform, investigate, urgent) with concrete metric rules (e.g., 20% regional latency degradation sustained >30m)
Console dashboard prototype showing top-10 model-risk vectors, time-series, and a linkable remediation playbook
Handoff runbook for Sales and SRE including email + pager templates and priority SLAs
deliverables: Confluence: Compass Beacon spec (signals, thresholds, playbooks)
Console: prototype dashboard mock and data schema for signal pipeline
Slack and email alert templates + recommended ownership matrix
Procurement trigger scoring algorithm (initial heuristic) with sample outputs
success_metrics: Median time-to-detect vendor-impacting signal <= 30 minutes for P1 triggers
Mean time-to-action (first mitigative step taken) <= 4 hours for urgent triggers
Reduction in unplanned vendor-change incidents that cause customer-impacting degradations by 40% in first quarter after launch
Sales/Solutions NPS on procurement guidance >= 8/10 in post-runbook survey
